drivers.name: Seed price/mix and volumes
drivers.last_report: 1H Seed sales +4%, organic +3%; price/mix +3%, volume flat. 2Q sales flat, price/mix +3%, volume -3% on acre shifts/timing.
drivers.guidance: FY Seed demand supported by differentiated technologies; no segment guidance.

drivers.name: Crop Protection pricing and demand
drivers.last_report: 1H CP sales +3%, organic -1%; volume +2%, price -3%. 2Q sales -4%, organic -6%; price -4%, volume -2%, Latin America pressure.
drivers.guidance: Normalized channel inventories and improving fundamentals; no segment guidance.

drivers.name: Operating EBITDA margin and cost
drivers.last_report: 1H Operating EBITDA $3.70B, +10%; margin +235 bps Seed, +120 bps CP. 2Q EBITDA +4%, margin +190 bps.
drivers.guidance: FY Operating EBITDA $4.1-$4.3B; Operating EPS $3.60-$3.80; includes $25M separation headwind.

drivers.name: Separation execution and dis-synergies
drivers.last_report: On-track for October 1 Vylor spin-off; boards, Form 10, capital structure progress. Net dis-synergies largely offset on run-rate basis.
drivers.guidance: Targeting October 1 separation; $25M headwind included in FY 2026 guidance.

drivers.name: Regional demand, currency and weather
drivers.last_report: 1H organic: North America +2%, EMEA +1%, Latin America -3%, Asia Pacific +7%. Currency favorable, led by Euro and Brazilian Real.
drivers.guidance: Trade, currency, weather to influence conditions; overall end-market consumption durable.

card.guidance: FY 2026: Operating EBITDA $4.1-$4.3B (9% growth at midpoint); Operating EPS $3.60-$3.80 (11% growth at midpoint); includes $25M separation headwind. No quarterly guidance.
kill_conditions: Corteva cuts FY 2026 Operating EBITDA guidance below $4.1B.
Crop Protection price declines worsen in Latin America or North America volume falls further.
October 1 Vylor separation delayed or separation costs exceed $25M headwind.

drivers.name: Net sales and volume recovery
drivers.last_report: Q1 net sales $935.6M, up 4.8%, in line with $915-955M guidance; 3% pricing, 1% FX, 1% organic volume.
drivers.guidance: Q2 net sales $955-995M; expects higher topline growth later in FY27 on material handling recovery.

drivers.name: IRC 45X credit benefits
drivers.last_report: Q1 adjusted EPS ex-45X $2.41; 45X boosted adjusted EPS by $1.25; GM ex-45X 28.5%, up 440 bps.
drivers.guidance: Q2 IRC 45X benefits to cost of sales $42-47M; adjusted EPS $3.15-3.25 inclusive; ex-45X $1.95-2.05.

drivers.name: Gross margin and price/mix
drivers.last_report: Q1 gross margin 33.5%, up 510 bps; ex-45X 28.5%, up 440 bps, helped by favorable price/mix.
drivers.guidance: Q2 outlook implies margin expansion; no explicit gross margin guidance. FY27 growth first from margin expansion, then topline.

drivers.name: Segment mix and material handling
drivers.last_report: NIS and PPS improved volumes and price/mix; IMS soft on prolonged material handling recovery. Data centers, communications, aerospace/defense strong.
drivers.guidance: Q2 reflects strength in data centers, communications, aerospace/defense, early transportation recovery; material handling recovery expected later FY27.

drivers.name: Tariff refunds and one-time items
drivers.last_report: Q1 included $30.9M tariff refunds; adjusted EPS ex-45X and refunds $1.78, up 42%.
drivers.guidance: Q2 guidance does not mention tariff refunds; adjusted EPS ex-45X $1.95-2.05 vs Q1 $1.78 ex-45X/refunds.

card.guidance: Q2 FY27: net sales $955-995M; IRC 45X benefits to cost of sales $42-47M; adjusted diluted EPS $3.15-3.25; adjusted diluted EPS ex-45X $1.95-2.05. FY27 capex ~$70M.
kill_conditions: Q2 net sales below $955M or FY27 topline growth pushed further out.
IRC 45X benefits below $42M or adjusted EPS ex-45X below $1.95.
Gross margin ex-45X contracts, or material handling recovery delayed again.
